name: Licht Klein
source:
Nokto's older twin brother is as cold as ice. He hates being with people and is most often by himself. But when you find that he's kind, you hear about his shocking past that forced this gentle prince to put up so many walls. Will you be able to break these walls down? 

"You don't have to follow me. I'll never become king. There's no reason for you to get to know me."

[From in-game profile]
